item.title: PS5 Price Hike: Sony's First Console to Get Costlier
item.description: Sony's PlayStation 5 sees unprecedented price hikes through 2025‑2026, breaking the traditional cost‑down trend and reshaping the console market.

item.title: Sony Brings AI Upscaling to Standard PS5 with QSSR
item.description: Sony's Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR) adds AI upscaling to the base PS5, delivering a 1440p boost despite lacking dedicated ML hardware.

item.title: How to Add Bluetooth Audio to PS5 with a USB‑C Adapter
item.description: Learn why the PS5 lacks native Bluetooth audio, how a USB‑C Bluetooth adapter works, and which low‑latency headsets deliver Sony’s Tempest 3D sound.
